requirements.condition: For packets other than Version Negotiation packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet-type-specific tests can verify that authenticated encryption is applied to every packet type except Version Negotiation.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not apply the authenticated encryption packet protection that applies to protected packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Generated Version Negotiation packets can be inspected to verify that protected-packet authenticated encryption is absent.

requirements.quote:
An attacker that injects packets without being able to observe valid
   packets for a connection is unlikely to be successful, since packet
   protection ensures that valid packets are only generated by endpoints
   that possess the key material established during the handshake; see
requirements.condition: When generating a packet that will be valid for a connection.
requirements.required_behavior: The generating endpoint must possess the key material established during the handshake.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not generate a packet deemed valid without possession of the connection's handshake-established key material.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can attempt packet generation and validation with and without the connection's established key material.

requirements.quote:
Sections 7 and 21.1.1.  Similarly, any active attacker that observes
   packets and attempts to insert new data or modify existing data in
   those packets should not be able to generate packets deemed valid by
   the receiving endpoint, other than Initial packets.
requirements.condition: When a non-Initial packet has had new data inserted or existing data modified by an entity lacking valid packet-generation authority.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The receiving endpoint must not deem the altered packet valid.
requirements.why_checkable: A receiver can be given tampered protected packets and checked to ensure that non-Initial packets are not accepted as valid.

requirements.condition: When processing a protected packet payload.
requirements.required_behavior: Only an endpoint that completed the handshake may process the packet payload.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: An endpoint that did not complete the handshake must not process the protected packet payload.
requirements.why_checkable: Endpoint state and payload-processing events can be observed to verify that processing occurs only after handshake completion.

requirements.condition: When a datagram contains an Initial packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The datagram must include required padding.
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized datagrams containing Initial packets can be inspected for the required padding.

requirements.quote:
padding, modification of how packets are arranged in datagrams has no
   functional effect on a connection, although it might change some
   performance characteristics.
requirements.condition: When packet-to-datagram boundaries or coalescing are modified for datagrams not subject to the Initial-packet padding exception.
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve the connection's functional behavior despite the changed packet arrangement.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not make connection semantics depend on whether packets are coalesced into one datagram or split across multiple datagrams.
requirements.why_checkable: Equivalent packet sequences can be delivered using different datagram groupings and their resulting connection state and outputs compared.
